title: APi Group: Safety Services at Scale - [Business Breakdowns, EP.205]

reader_summary.source_label: From the episode notes — transcript not yet available
reader_summary.headline: Today, we are breaking down APi Group.
reader_summary.overview: Today, we are breaking down APi Group, a leading provider of life safety and specialty services to buildings and construction projects. While not necessarily a household name, APi's services play a vital role in the buildings where we live and work. With over 100 acquisitions under their belt.

key_points.text: With over 100 acquisitions under their belt.
The evolution of the business has come via an intentional shift from one-off construction projects to a recurring revenue model.
To help us break down APi, I am joined by Adam Wyden and Chadd Garcia.
